agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Caller-authored receipt evidence must contain no Git object ID; the machine snapshot alone owns exact Git identities.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first preplanning runtime draft repeated full Git object IDs inside two descriptive evidence fields.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The orchestrator preflight rejected the draft with git_refs_evidence_manual_object_id_forbidden before any dispatch or publication.

correction.action: Remove every caller-authored Git identity and regenerate the receipt from the machine snapshot.
correction.prevention_control: Continuation runtime descriptions state relations without object IDs; the preflight remains the exclusive Git-identity projector.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected caller-authored Git identities and machine-only receipt correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Provider-free cached-source reading must not depend on HOME or another environment-derived user directory.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first implementation derived the npm cache with Path.home(), and two focused checks failed when the provider-free environment did not expose a usable home coordinate.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The first focused pytest run failed only the cache-root dependent source binding and generated-evidence checks before any Node, Harness or provider activity.

correction.action: Resolve the exact cache from the repository parent and rerun all source bindings.
correction.prevention_control: The diagnostic source reader contains no HOME or environment lookup and its focused suite runs under the provider-free wrapper.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the environment-derived cache root and repository-bound provider-free correction.
